description.zh:
创建的AMQP订阅中的消费组ID，**Type**为**AMQP**时必填。

调用[CreateConsumerGroup](~~170388~~)创建消费组成功后，会返回消费组ID。您可以调用[QueryConsumerGroupList](~~170419~~)按消费组名称查询消费组ID，也可以在物联网平台控制台<props="china"><ph>对应实例下</ph></props>，选择**消息转发**>**服务端订阅**>**消费组列表**，查看消费组ID。
description.en:
The consumer group IDs in the created AMQP subscription. This parameter is required when **Type** is set to **AMQP**.  

After you call [CreateConsumerGroup](~~170388~~) to create a consumer group, the consumer group ID is returned. You can call [QueryConsumerGroupList](~~170419~~) to query the consumer group ID by consumer group name. Alternatively, in the IoT Platform console<props="china"><ph>under the corresponding instance</ph></props>, choose **Message Forwarding** > **Server-side Subscription** > **Consumer Group List** to view the consumer group ID.

标识当前订阅产品的其他类型消息，数据格式为JSON String。

- 如果订阅的是JT/T 808协议云网关产品，必须传入**SubscribeFlags**，取值为：

    ```
    {
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```

- 如果订阅的是设备视频流状态变更通知消息，必须传入**SubscribeFlags**，取值为：

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true
    }
    ```
    配置AMQP服务端订阅**设备视频流状态变更通知**消息的详细内容，请参见[AMQP服务端订阅](~~2698782~~)。

- 如果同时订阅以上消息，取值为：

    ```
    {
        "lvDeviceStatusFlag": true,
        "jt808DeviceDataFlag": true
    }
    ```

{

title.en: Create an MNS or AMQP server-side subscription

descriptions.zh:
## 使用说明
服务端订阅分两种类型：
- MNS订阅：将订阅的消息推送到消息服务（MNS）的队列中，您的服务端应用通过监听MNS队列接收设备消息，参见[使用MNS服务端订阅](~~68948~~)。直接调用本接口即可创建MNS订阅。
- AMQP订阅：将产品下所有已订阅类型的消息通过AMQP通道推送至您的服务端，请参见[配置AMQP服务端订阅](~~142376~~)。请按以下流程操作AMQP订阅：
1. 调用[CreateConsumerGroup](~~170388~~)创建消费组，返回消费组ID。AMQP订阅中，消息将被推送到指定消费组，AMQP客户端携带消费组ID接入物联网平台，消费消息，请参见[AMQP客户端接入说明](~~142489~~)。
2. 调用本接口创建AMQP订阅。
3. （可选）调用[CreateConsumerGroupSubscribeRelation](~~170354~~)在AMQP订阅中添加消费组。调用[DeleteConsumerGroupSubscribeRelation](~~170357~~)删除AMQP订阅中多个消费组中的指定消费组。
4. （可选）运行AMQP订阅时，调用[QueryConsumerGroupStatus](~~170358~~)查询某个消费组的状态，包括在线客户端信息、消息消费速率、消息堆积数、最近消息消费时间，调用[ResetConsumerGroupPosition](~~170355~~)清空消费组的堆积消息。

## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。</props>

  > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## How-To  
Server-side subscriptions are available in two types:  
- **MNS subscription**: Subscribed messages are pushed to a queue in Message Service (MNS). Your server application receives device messages by listening to the MNS queue. For more information, see [Use MNS server-side subscription](~~68948~~). You can directly call this API to create an MNS subscription.  
- **AMQP subscription**: All subscribed messages under a product are pushed to your server through an AMQP channel. For more information, see [Configure AMQP server-side subscription](~~142376~~). Follow these steps to manage AMQP subscriptions:  
  1. Call [CreateConsumerGroup](~~170388~~) to create a consumer group and obtain the consumer group ID. In AMQP subscriptions, messages are pushed to the specified consumer group. Your AMQP client connects to IoT Platform using the consumer group ID to consume messages. For more information, see [AMQP client connection guide](~~142489~~).  
  2. Call this API to create an AMQP subscription.  
  3. (Optional) Call [CreateConsumerGroupSubscribeRelation](~~170354~~) to add a consumer group to the AMQP subscription. Call [DeleteConsumerGroupSubscribeRelation](~~170357~~) to remove a specific consumer group from multiple consumer groups in the AMQP subscription.  
  4. (Optional) While the AMQP subscription is running, call [QueryConsumerGroupStatus](~~170358~~) to query the status of a consumer group, including online client information, message consumption rate, number of accumulated messages, and the time of the most recent message consumption. Call [ResetConsumerGroupPosition](~~170355~~) to delete accumulated messages in the consumer group.

## Queries per second (QPS) limit  

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for this API per Alibaba Cloud account is 5.</props>

  > Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
